videos.title: L3Harris Recruiting Video - UAA Remix
videos.description:
Song: Mantra

Artist: Noisia



Always interested to see what music can do to catalyse a new edit as an alternative, disruptive, look with existing creative.



As quick excercise I took two L3Harris Technologies videos and worked with the song "Mantra" by Noisia. 



Consider it a recruiting edit, I considered having a text bumper at the end, with "Consider Yourself Recruited" and then prompting a . and ? animation after to the careers link, and opted out - keeping the closing, abrupt pamphlet drop clip at the end.



Enjoy

videos.title: UAA 2025
videos.description:
𝖴𝖭𝗛𝗘𝗔𝗥𝗗 | 𝖴𝖠𝖠

Social Creative Reel 2025 



Song: Space Clash

Artist: TRAKA



04/02/25:



While I continue to look for a new full-time role, I have begun to start building UAA: Unheard Artists Agency, which will service small businesses, events, and organizations in the City of Rochester and WNY - fueled by the voices of Artists and Creatives who are fearless, passionate, inspired, and boundless.  



I fell in love with Rochester after moving to East Aurora for a year after living in Los Angeles all my life and have been here the past 7 months, a true new home. I continue to be amazed at the intense amount of creative talent here and history. 



I am a huge fan of small businesses and authentic connection with the business they are doing, there is an intimacy there that is raw and I gravitate towards that. 



There are a wealth of small agencies doing compelling work that is exceptionally stellar and I am excited to join the dance over time in our own way.  



Here is a beautiful track here that speaks volumes by Machinedrum and aja monet, titled "ORACLE" which expresses perhaps a bit how UAA approaches dancing, which is a mirror of reverence in many a way, which I will link here, lyrics below:



https://lnkd.in/g6V5CTHq



"Your excitement is exciting for me

I'm remembering excitement

It's like when they say you know how you look

Based on how someone else looks at you

Seeing the excitement on your face

Brings out the excitement in me

It reminds me that I'm beautiful

That there's something special about me

It's 'cos I can see that there's something special about you too

Really?



Why don't you like dancing alone

You know what that's real



That's true

When I dance alone

I'm not worried about someone else's rhythm

I'm learning how to move with myself

And then when I dance with someone

I can share what moves I've learned

You know

You can show them where to go

You can show them where to go

Show them where to go

Show them where to go

Show them where to go

Show them where to go

It's one thing to figure out how your body moves

When you're with another person

But it's another thing to figure out

How your body moves when you're with yourself

'Cos then you kinda know

A little bit more of what you want to do when you're with them"



It is exciting to me to start to find and meet both small business owners and artists in and around the city that I am inspired by, and hope to contribute to their visions! 



This updated reel was superfun to create, as I wanted to meet both my needs as the founder and first artist of UAA, while being a job seeker in a brutal market.



Grateful, blessed, focused



Looking forward to working together, or connecting in the city



Vimeo: https://lnkd.in/deHVGRBt



𝖴𝖭𝗛𝗘𝗔𝗥𝗗 | 𝖴𝖠𝖠 : https://lnkd.in/gaj4XX5G

videos.title: PEPE IS LOVE
videos.description:
The problem with Pepe is that he’s been stamped a hate symbol by politicians, hate groups, institutions, the media and, because of them, your mom. Before he got wrapped up in politics, Pepe was an inside-joke and a symbol for feeling sad or feeling good and many things in between. I understand that it’s out of my control, but in the end, Pepe is whatever you say he is, and I, the creator, say that Pepe is love.



- Matt Furie
